closure_rule.physics: Latent-HMC agrees with independent full-measure Gauss-Hermite quadrature for all primary observables across all five couplings.
closure_rule.reference: Free Wilson determinant, force, Gauss-Hermite convergence, Gaussian g=0 baseline, condensate thermodynamic identity, and nontrivial response all pass.
closure_rule.sampler: Every Yukawa coupling group passes the frozen HMC quality gate.

rescue_preregistration.constant_observable_tau_rule: If max absolute deviation from the mean is <= 1e-12 * max(1,abs(mean)), assign tau_int=0.5.
rescue_preregistration.integrator_change: Use fixed n_leapfrog=3 and adapt leapfrog epsilon directly rather than holding trajectory length fixed.
rescue_preregistration.reason: Original physics/reference gates passed. Formal sampler gate failed because g=0 condensate is deterministic but was assigned maximal autocorrelation, and fixed-trajectory step quantization left all chains at acceptance ~0.97.
